title: DECISION: Integration test oracles are offline-computed, not self-certifying
description: peer_attachment_fetch.rs uses offline-computed constants (EXPECTED_SHA256, EXPECTED_CHAT_ID) and verifies them independently (lines 132-149): EXPECTED_SHA256 tested against sha2::Sha256, EXPECTED_CHAT_ID tested against kith_core::compute_chat_id. Test does not self-certify. Demonstrates test integrity: oracle is external to code-under-test.
